cvEn:
Eran Shoham, son of Avigail and Shalom, was born on the 4th of Heshvan 5730 (16 October 1969) in Hadera. He grew up and was educated in his hometown and began his studies at Bilu Elementary School, where he studied until seventh grade. He then transferred to Tahkhamoni School, where he completed his elementary education. He began his high-school studies at the Bar Ilan religious high school in Netanya, and at the end of tenth grade he moved to the agricultural school in Pardes Hanna, where he studied for half a year, and then continued at the 'Iron' agricultural school in Hadera.

In 1986, at the age of seventeen, he went to the 'Ein Gedi' field school, where he stayed and worked for about half a year. At the same time, he joined the 'Pashush' garin within HaNoar HaOved VeHaLomed and went to train at Kibbutz Beit HaShita in the Jezreel Valley.

In January 1988 he was drafted into the IDF and went to basic training in Nahal. During his training, on the 8th of Iyar 5748 (25 April 1988), he fell during his service. He was laid to rest in the military cemetery in Hadera. He is survived by his parents, his brother Doron, and his sister Hila. His parents perpetuated his memory in a book they published.
